sourceBoundary.topicHeading: 1 The nature and variety of living organisms
sourceBoundary.nextTopicHeading: 2 Structure and functions in living organisms
sourceBoundary.judgement: Visually reviewed PDF pages 17–18 contain the entire topic 1 point set 1.1–1.4; page 19 starts topic 2 at 2.1. Both 1B and 2B scope retained; local editorial requirements are not additional publisher points.

goalDecisions.goal: Explain the shared life processes in context.
goalDecisions.judgement: Eight life characteristics assessed in original observed cases, including growth/development/reproduction distinctions.

goalDecisions.goal: Distinguish respiration from breathing and excretion from egestion.
goalDecisions.judgement: Respiration/breathing and metabolic excretion/egestion distinctions assessed by the origin and role of the material.

goalDecisions.goal: Compare plants, animals, fungi and protoctists using several features.
goalDecisions.judgement: Several structural/nutrition features and named examples assessed; root-cell, yeast and protoctist exceptions retained.

goalDecisions.goal: Distinguish bacterial cells from viruses and explain what makes a pathogen.
goalDecisions.judgement: Cell versus particle organisation, genome/host dependence and pathogen/vector/disease distinctions assessed.

prerequisiteReview.judgement: One-cell/many-cell organisation is introduced as the prerequisite and revisited in eukaryote, fungus and bacterial comparisons. No unintroduced calculation technique is needed beyond stated unit conversion.

coherenceReview.judgement: The source-order explanatory sections introduce life processes, eukaryotic groups, bacteria and pathogens/viruses, followed by labelled evidence lessons and worked/unfamiliar tasks. All 17 sections are linked to their exact reviewed source identities; invented models and data are explicitly distinguished from real microscopy.

limitations: Authored teaching only. No human examiner review, learner trials or active generative exam bank.
Source completeness is bounded to the stated publisher topic; other chapters and the past-paper archive remain incomplete.

captionReview.scope: Two origin labels only. Prior source boundaries, goals, prerequisites, sequence and readiness limitations retained unchanged.
